national_news.title: India-New Zealand Free Trade Agreement to Enter into Force from October 20
bullets: Union Minister of Commerce and Industry Piyush Goyal announced that the India-New Zealand Free Trade Agreement (FTA) will come into effect on October 20.
The agreement provides 100% duty-free access for Indian exports to New Zealand, aiming to double bilateral trade in goods and services to nearly ₹35,000 crore within 4 to 5 years.
It aims to facilitate $20 billion in foreign investment into India while enhancing professional, student, and youth mobility pathways.

national_news.title: Asian Games: India Wins Multiple Medals in Shooting and Mixed Martial Arts
bullets: Himanshu Dhillon won silver and Rudrankksh Patil secured bronze in the men’s 10-metre air rifle individual event at the Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan.
India's men's 10m air rifle team, featuring Himanshu Dhillon, Rudrankksh Patil, and Parth Rakesh Mane, secured a silver medal.
Suchika Tariyal became the first Indian athlete to win a medal in Mixed Martial Arts (MMA) at the event, securing a bronze in the 60 kg category.

national_news.title: Media Delegation Visits J&K Infrastructure Projects and Reviews Development
bullets: A 10-member media delegation from Bhopal visited Jammu and Kashmir to review major developments in connectivity, infrastructure, and healthcare.
NHAI officials reported that 22 projects covering 382 km have been completed at a cost of Rs 14,819 crore, while 16 projects spanning 320 km are under implementation at Rs 22,277 crore.
The strategic Zojila Tunnel is expected to become operational by December 2027, significantly improving regional connectivity.

national_news.title: Directorate of Revenue Intelligence Seizes 845 kg of Contraband Drugs
bullets: The Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) seized over 845 kg of narcotic drugs and psychotropic substances in pan-India intelligence-led operations.
A total of 15 individuals were arrested under the provisions of the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (NDPS) Act, 1985.
Major seizures included 752.3 kg of ganja intercepted in Bodh Gaya, alongside operations in Odisha, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Gorakhpur, and Delhi airports.

national_news.title: Putin's United Russia Party Retains Majority in State Duma Elections
bullets: Russia's ruling United Russia party secured 57.83 percent of the votes in elections for the 9th State Duma, the lower house of parliament.
The State Duma is Russia's permanent legislative body composed of 450 deputies elected for a 5-year term.
Voter turnout for the election stood at 59.32 percent, higher than the 51.72 percent recorded in 2021.

national_news.title: PM-KISAN Scheme Continues to Benefit Farmers Nationwide
bullets: Under the PM-KISAN scheme, eligible farmers receive financial assistance of Rs 6,000 annually in three equal installments directly into their bank accounts via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
The Central Government has approved the continuation of the PM-KISAN scheme from 2026-27 to 2030-31 with a total financial provision of Rs 3.15 crore.
Since its inception in 2019, over Rs 4.47 lakh crore has been disbursed across 23 installments, benefiting over 9.49 crore farmers, including significant support for women farmers.

national_news.title: Ministry of Finance Appeals to Bank Unions Amid Strike Calls
bullets: Public Sector Bank and Regional Rural Bank unions called for strikes demanding the implementation of a five-day workweek and withdrawal of the Performance Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme.
The Government proactively addressed the unions' demands by keeping the PLI scheme in abeyance through detailed discussions and conciliation.
Between FY 2014-15 and FY 2025-26, Public Sector Banks recruited approximately 4,82,800 employees, alongside a 56% enhancement in the Staff Welfare Fund (SWF) in August 2024.

national_news.title: 72nd National Film Awards Announced for 2024
bullets: The 72nd National Film Awards ceremony is held at Ekta Nagar, Kevadia, Gujarat, on September 22, presented by the President of India.
Veteran actor Anant Nag is honored with the prestigious Dadasaheb Phalke Award for the year 2024 for his exceptional contribution to Indian cinema.
Major winners include 'Article 370' for Best Feature Film, Mammootty and Kartik Aaryan for Best Actor, and Yami Gautam for Best Actress.

national_news.title: National Steering Committee approves Rs 320 crore for Kurukshetra ITI cluster under PM-SETU
bullets: The National Steering Committee (NSC) approved a Strategic Investment Plan (SIP) worth Rs 320 crore under the PM-SETU scheme for the Kurukshetra ITI Cluster in Haryana.
This approval brings the cumulative PM-SETU investment to Rs 2,491 crore across 10 ITI clusters, according to the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE).
The PM-SETU scheme targets the modernization of 1,000 government ITIs nationwide through a hub-and-spoke model with a total broader outlay of Rs 60,000 crore.

national_news.title: Government Approves Continuation of PM-KISAN Scheme till 2030-31
bullets: The Central Government has approved the continuation of the Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) scheme for a five-year period from 2026-27 to 2030-31.
Launched in 2019, PM-KISAN provides eligible farmers with financial assistance of Rs 6,000 per year in three equal installments via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) and Aadhaar authentication.
Over Rs 4.47 lakh crore has been disbursed across 23 installments to date, benefiting more than 9.49 crore farmers, including over Rs 1.6 lakh crore transferred to women farmers.

national_news.title: Indian Air Force to Host Three-Day Air Show Over River Ganges in Varanasi
bullets: The Indian Air Force (IAF) is scheduled to organize a three-day aerial display over the River Ganges in Varanasi from October 22 to 25.
Over three dozen aircraft will participate, including Rafale and Tejas fighter jets, C-295 transport planes, Rudra helicopters, Dakota aircraft, and the Suryakiran aerobatic team.
The air show will span across 84 ghats from Namo Ghat to Assi Ghat, with Namo Ghat acting as the central control hub for operations.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Panchayat Polls Postponed Until Delimitation Completion
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary announced that the next three-tier panchayat elections will be held only after the completion of the delimitation process by the State Election Commission.
The state government aims to target a prosperous and empowered Bihar by the year 2037, marking significant developmental milestones.
Key welfare measures include providing agricultural electricity at 55 paise per unit, 125 units of free monthly electricity per family, and targeting employment for 1 crore people before 2030.

bihar_news.title: Magahi Paan Growers Leverage GI Status and Collective Farming in Bihar
bullets: Magahi Paan, cultivated in Bihar's Magadh region (Aurangabad, Gaya, Nawada, and Nalanda districts), received Geographical Indication (GI) registration on March 28, 2018.
The ICAR-AICRP-MAP&B (Islampur Centre, BAU Sabour) supported farmers in obtaining GI authorised-user registration, covering 1,001 farmers.
The Renu and Rajendra Magahi Paan Producer Company Limited was registered on September 11, 2023, under the Companies Act, 2013, to boost branding, marketing, and value chain enhancement.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Team to Study Uttar Pradesh's Digital Sugarcane Management System
bullets: A three-member delegation from Bihar visited Lucknow to study Uttar Pradesh's Smart Sugarcane Farmer Portal and e-Ganna app.
The study focuses on digital systems for online sugarcane surveys, basic quota allocation, cane supply estimates, and transparent supply slip issuance.
The delegation also examined real-time cane supply tracking and time-bound online grievance redressal mechanisms for farmers.

bihar_news.title: West Bengal Government Launches 'Seva First Innovation Challenge' for Eastern Zone
bullets: The West Bengal government launched the 'Seva First Innovation Challenge – Eastern Zone' targeting innovators from West Bengal, Bihar, and Jharkhand.
Organized by the Department of Science & Technology and Biotechnology (DSTBT) under the 'Seva Sankalp Abhiyan 2026' at IIT Kharagpur Research Park.
The challenge invites participation across Junior and Open categories focusing on healthcare, agriculture, water shortages, waste management, and disaster preparedness.

bihar_news.title: Railway Board Approves Rs 383.78 Crore Vande Bharat Maintenance Depot at Tatanagar
bullets: The Railway Board sanctioned a Rs 383.78 crore project to establish a Vande Bharat maintenance depot at Tatanagar railway station in Jamshedpur.
The new facility in the Loco Colony area will extend the existing coaching depot to support technical inspections, servicing, and rapid washing.
The maintenance depot is designed to accommodate both Chair Car and Sleeper Vande Bharat trainsets.

bihar_news.title: Agricultural University VCs Visit ICAR-ATARI Umiam to Discuss Extension Strategies
bullets: Dr. P.S. Pandey, VC of Dr. Rajendra Prasad Central Agricultural University (RPCAU), Pusa, Bihar, and Dr. A.K. Singh, VC of RLBCAU Jhansi, visited ICAR-ATARI, Umiam, Meghalaya.
Discussions focused on strengthening Krishi Vigyan Kendras (KVKs) as long-term institutions for technology dissemination and livelihood enhancement.
The meeting emphasized context-specific approaches for agricultural extension in the complex, risk-prone, and biodiverse North-Eastern region.

bihar_news.title: Surging Demand for GI-Tagged Marcha Chuda of West Champaran
bullets: Demand for West Champaran's aromatic 'Marcha Chuda' (flattened rice) has surged domestically and internationally following its GI tag award.
The paddy variety is traditionally cultivated using organic methods without chemical fertilizers in Champaran soil, known for its unique black peppercorn-like grain shape and distinct aroma.
Marcha Chuda sells for approximately Rs 150 per kilogram, boosting farmers' incomes and being transported to states like Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal, Odisha, Uttarakhand, and Jharkhand.

bihar_news.title: ICC Global Business Summit 2026 Focuses on Eastern India's Growth Corridor
bullets: The ICC Global Business Summit 2026 commenced in New Delhi under the theme 'Reinventing Global Business: Growth, Risk & Resilience'.
Ministers from Assam, West Bengal, and Bihar presented investment potential in line with the Central Government's 'Purvodaya' vision for Eastern India.
The summit showcased key regional industrial advancements, including semiconductor assembly projects, multi-modal logistics hubs, and renewable energy infrastructure targets.
